scope: Initial future-host extraction: shared error type and atomic configuration IO, with Desktop facades and CLI dependency.

environment.cargoTargetDir: Shared local root target for incremental compilation; not a matched performance measurement.

checks.name: Host test-support test-target lint
checks.command: RUSTC_WRAPPER= cargo clippy --offline --locked -p future-host --features test-support --all-targets -- -D warnings

checks.name: CLI and GUI consumers
checks.command: RUSTC_WRAPPER= cargo clippy --offline --locked -p future-cli -p futureos --all-targets -- -D warnings

checks.name: Existing headless consumer
checks.command: RUSTC_WRAPPER= cargo clippy --offline --locked -p futureos --no-default-features --features headless --all-targets -- -D warnings

limits: Native macOS compilation/static evidence only; no unit, network or product runtime acceptance.
Host lifecycle/event APIs and the bulk of application backend migration remain incomplete.
The future headless entry and build/release migration are not implemented yet.
Dependency counts are not performance evidence.
